{
  "concordance_metric": "sensitivity",
  "concordance_value": 0.969,
  "n_pairs": 55,
  "n_animal_studies": null,
  "n_human_studies": null,
  "species_results": [],
  "two_by_two": {
    "tp": null,
    "fp": null,
    "fn": null,
    "tn": null
  },
  "sensitivity": 0.969,
  "specificity": 0.565,
  "ppv": null,
  "npv": null,
  "endpoints_animal": [
    "hERG IC50",
    "Cav1.2 IC50",
    "Nav1.5 IC50",
    "hERG ETPC Index",
    "Cav1.2 ETPC Index",
    "Nav1.5 ETPC Index",
    "CavD"
  ],
  "endpoints_human": [
    "Torsade de Pointes (TdP)",
    "QT prolongation"
  ],
  "endpoint_class": "primary-hard",
  "concordance_definition": "The study aimed to improve TdP predictivity by comparing models based on hERG block alone versus models incorporating multiple ion channel effects (MICE). Concordance is implicitly defined by the improved predictive accuracy (sensitivity, specificity, AUC) of the MICE models compared to the hERG-only model in classifying drugs as torsadogenic or non-torsadogenic.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "Reduced precision of Nav1.5 currents at larger values due to concentrations that approached the solubility limit, requiring that IC50 values be extrapolated assuming a Hill coefficient equal to 1.",
    "The unbound effective therapeutic plasma concentration (ETPC) for each drug was collected from the literature or calculated from Cmax and percent protein binding data found in the literature, with potential lab-to-lab variability.",
    "Limited solubility of some drugs in the buffer.",
    "All recordings were performed at ambient temperatures, which may differ from physiological temperatures.",
    "Effects on ion channels other than hERG, Nav1.5 and Cav1.2 were not considered.",
    "Models may misidentify drugs that exclusively inhibit the surface expression of hERG.",
    "Trafficking data is only available for seven of the drugs in the training set.",
    "The restricted size of the dataset made it impossible to have separate 'training' and 'test' sets.",
    "Variability in Cav1.2 IC50 values for some drugs may make assigned torsadogenic risk probabilities less certain.",
    "The classification of voriconazole as a torsadogenic drug may be questionable due to co-occurring risk factors in reported TdP cases.",
    "Reasons for false classification of dasatinib and donepezil are difficult to explain, potentially due to the model being overly sensitive to certain profile characteristics.",
    "The study did not consider other ion channels besides hERG, Cav1.2, and Nav1.5."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "32 torsadogenic (+TdP) drugs and 23 non-torsadogenic (-TdP) drugs were tested.",
    "55 drugs were included in the dataset.",
    "Model 1 (hERG alone) had a false positive rate of 56.5%.",
    "Model 5 (CavD) had a false positive rate of 17.4%.",
    "The AUC increased by 16 ± 9% with Model 5 compared to Model 1.",
    "Model 1 misclassified 14 drugs.",
    "Model 5 misclassified 5 drugs.",
    "Compared to Model 1, false positives were halved and false negatives reduced six-fold with Model 5.",
    "The hERG IC50 is 30-fold above the ETPC is a threshold for torsadogenic drugs.",
    "Model 1 falsely identified verapamil as torsadogenic with a probability (P(+TdP) = 0.90).",
    "Model 5 correctly identified verapamil as non-torsadogenic (P(+TdP) = 0.31).",
    "Model 1 identified terfenadine with a probability (P(+TdP) = 0.81).",
    "Model 5 identified terfenadine as torsadogenic (P(+TdP) = 0.97).",
    "Under Model 5, voriconazole was identified as a false negative.",
    "Under Model 5, telbivudine, loratadine, dasatinib and donepezil were identified as false positives.",
    "Model 1 had fourteen falsely categorized drugs: ceftriaxone, linezolid, metronidazole, phenytoin, piperacillin, ribavirin, telbivudine and verapamil were false positives whereas amiodarone, cilostazol, paroxetine, risperidone, solifenacin and sunitinib were false negatives.",
    "Model 5 had one false negative drug (voriconazole) and four false positives (dasatinib, donepezil, loratadine and telbivudine).",
    "The conventional approach using a 30-fold cutoff value resulted in 16 misidentified drugs.",
    "Approximately 90% of all drugs withdrawn from the market are linked to toxicity and safety.",
    "TdP is associated with a death rate of about 20%."
  ]
}
